title: A service's states
description:
Model the states a Windows service reports to the Service Control Manager.

```
start      -> START_PENDING (checkpoint 1, 2, 3) -> RUNNING
pause      -> PAUSE_PENDING -> PAUSED
stop       -> STOP_PENDING -> STOPPED
pause while STOPPED -> refused
```
hints: A table of `(state, request) -> next state` keeps the rules in one place (lesson 7.04).
The real service calls `SetServiceStatus` each time with the state, checkpoint and wait hint.
requirements: An enum of the service states and a function for each control request.
Pending states report an increasing checkpoint and a wait hint.
Refuse controls that make no sense in the current state.
stretch: Time out a pending state that has not reported progress within its wait hint.
